info.title: StockTank API
info.description: Identity, RBAC, public content, advertising, marketing and system endpoints for StockTank. Sessions are cookie-based; state-changing requests must send `X-Requested-With`. Financial content served by this platform is informational only and never investment advice.

servers.description: Same origin (dev proxy or deployed API host)
